polishes.name: Smooth Moves Glitter Smoothing Top Coat

polishes.name: Squadghouls
polishes.description: Just like your favorite fluffy fair treat, this radiant pink polish is almost too sweet to believe! Warm peach and gold tones dance across the base, but with a shift in lighting or angle, cooler hues emerge. Fuchsia and raspberry shimmer light up the surface, while soft touches of lavender and periwinkle add an extra swirl of sugary charm. Photos credit to _always_polished_, cosmeticsanctuary, manicentric, cheyennexodeborah, thepolishedmage, doseoflolade, the_polished_life, pamperedpolishes, xo.krista

polishes.name: Stalk Market
polishes.stock_status: Give your next manicure the VIP treatment. This silver holographic topper nail polish echoes the beauty of the night sky, featuring mini holo stars, crescent moons, and a mix of silver hex glitters floating in a crystal-clear base. It’s the easiest way to achieve a star-studded galaxy look on your nails! Photos credit to _always_polished_, thepolishedmage, xo.krista, doseoflolade, cheyennexodeborah, cosmeticsanctuary, the_polished_life

polishes.name: Stay Put Hydrating Base Coat
polishes.stock_status: Keep your polish perfect and your nails hydrated with this base coat, featuring Prickly Pear extract, seaweed, and Vitamin E for long-lasting moisture and protection.

Grab your magnet to make the color-shifting flakes and micro holo glitter pop against a dramatic black base; your friends won't believe their eyes!
